# BrightPath Eduvora - 1:1 Online Tuition Academy

> BrightPath Eduvora is Kerala's premier personalized 1:1 online tuition academy for students from Kindergarten (KG) to 12th Grade. We provide certified expert tutors, flexible scheduling (5:00 AM – 11:00 PM IST), and customized learning roadmaps across CBSE, ICSE, Kerala State, and IGCSE curriculums.

## Core Information
- **Institution Name**: BrightPath Eduvora
- **Alternate Name**: BrightPath Online Tuition Academy
- **Website**: https://www.brightpatheduvora.com
- **Headquarters**: Mavoor Road, Calicut, Kerala, India - 673001
- **Contact Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 85908 78148
- **Email**: brightpathacademycalicut@gmail.com
- **Delivery Model**: 100% Live 1:1 Online Mentorship with interactive whiteboards
- **Grades Covered**: KG, Class 1, Class 2, Class 3, Class 4, Class 5, Class 6, Class 7, Class 8, Class 9, Class 10 (SSLC/CBSE/ICSE), Class 11 & Class 12 (Plus One & Plus Two)
- **Supported Boards**: CBSE (NCERT), ICSE & ISC (CISCE), Kerala State Board (SCERT), Cambridge IGCSE
- **Languages of Instruction**: English, Malayalam, and bilingual instruction
